PNP acting chief Lt. Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. and the Highway Patrol Group (HPG) on Friday (Dec. 19, 2025) present smuggled cigarettes worth PHP143 million seized by HPG operatives from two container trucks that were apprehended along Araneta Avenue in Quezon City for traffic violations on Dec. 17.

HPG also confiscated the money used by the drivers of the trucks to bribe apprehending officers. | @LloydCaliwan
